security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Upload a RAR, ZIP, 7z or tar archive to an FTP server without extracting it
bundle.longDescription: rarftp-gui streams the contents of a RAR, ZIP, 7z or tar archive to an FTP server without extracting anything to disk. Files are decompressed and verified on the fly while they are uploaded.
